thread:
jason: Starting a quick sync on HW partner + orchestrator preflight for ISV tooling listings. Need to lock the verification checklist.
anika: Good call. We keep getting late surprises when SI partners assume our routing supports custom gateway headers.
li: propose a compatibility matrix: orchestrator versions (v1/v2), gateway auth schemes, and required env vars. Simple CSV attached in draft.
jason: place the CSV in the partner repo template. Also call out minimum GPU SKU we support for baseline perf.
suhail: on perf: we only need a lightweight probe: 50 short prompts and measure p50/p95 and tokens/sec. No heavy load.
emily: agree. Also capture model variants they tested (fp16, int8, q4_0) so we can recommend quantization settings in listing.
partner-ops-bot: preflight-job queued: id=preflight-2026-04-02T09:12Z. status=pending.
anika: for hardware partners, add a small passive check that the adapter exposes memory metrics and NVLink if present. Helps SRE triage.
li: noted. I'll add a sample promql we expect: `sum(container_memory_rss_bytes) by (container)` and a small dashboard snapshot in the repo.
suhail: legal ask: partners must state whether user prompts are persisted and the retention window. We need that for marketplace metadata.
jem: (typo) — jason: good catch. Add a checkbox: "persists_user_data": yes/no + retention_days.
emily: marketing wants a one-paragraph blurb and one screenshot for the marketplace tile. Keep it short.
anika: on joint announcements: require tech sign-off + partner marketing go-ahead. No announcement until preflight passes and legal confirms data handling.
li: orchestration edge case: some partners run multi-model routing. We should require a fallback mapping when a model is unavailable (e.g., map llama2 -> redwood-compat). Provide example mapping YAML:```yaml
model_map:
  llama2-13b: redwood-13b-compat
  local-lite: redwood-lite
```
suhail: that YAML will be part of our verification harness. We'll try a failover by killing the primary container. If partner fails auto-failover, flag as P2.
anika: CI requirement: add a `preflight/check.yml` GH action that runs our smoke runner on PRs. Small script, no infra costs.
partner-ops-bot: preflight-job update: id=preflight-2026-04-02T09:12Z -> running. logs=/ci/preflight/2109999999.log
emily: also ask HW partners to include expected power/perf envelope if they expose that. Helpful for enterprise procurement.
li: I'll put together a one-page checklist and a sample verification repo. Will ping everyone for feedback.
suhail: timeline: aim for a 5 business day turnaround after partner provides sandbox credentials. If they fail CI twice, escalate to partner success.
anjason: (typo) — jason: we should be explicit on announcement cadence: internal heads-up at T+0, public post only after cert pass and partner consent.
anika: accessibility quick-check for sample UI optional but recommended for enterprise customers.
partner-ops-bot: preflight-job update: id=preflight-2026-04-02T09:12Z -> completed. result=partial-pass. See /ci/preflight/2109999999.log for failures.
emily: thanks. Let's debrief with partner tomorrow and share remediation items.
li: will attach the draft repo link and CSV in #partnerships after lunch.
